integrity: All line-scheme statements follow from six explicitly verified Grassmannian charts, degree-nine additive-polynomial Frobenius identities, and the smooth-quartic normal bundle calculation. Finite computations are checks, not substituted for general proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only the coefficient-one model of Veniani Example 5.1 over the prime field is addressed; neither generic family fibers nor the K3 surface zeta function are computed. A complete historical uniqueness search is not claimed.
title: Eight-cycle Frobenius splitting of the 58 lines on a characteristic-three quartic
